description.en_US: Canvas app plugin for Agent-managed tldraw infinite canvases, AI image holders, annotation workflows, autosaved viewport snapshots, reviewable versions, and an editable workbench.
description.zh_Hans: 面向 Agent 协作创作的 Canvas 画布插件，支持 tldraw 无限画布、AI 图片占位、标注迭代、视口快照自动保存、可审核版本和可编辑工作台。
